title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical portra
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, seated at a formal indoor wedding banquet or elegant reception dinner. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth light skin with warm-neutral undertones and realistic natural texture, a petite softly oval face, a delicate tapered jawline, a small refined nose, softly defined cheekbones, naturally pink lips, and large dark-brown almond-shaped eyes. Her neatly groomed brows are medium-dark and softly arched. She turns her head slightly toward her right, looking off-camera with a bright, cheerful expression and a wide natural smile showing her teeth. Her makeup is polished and youthful, with subtle eyeliner, softly defined lashes, luminous complexion, restrained blush, and natural rosy lip color.

Her medium-to-dark brown hair is styled in an elegant bridal updo, gathered high at the back with a large soft white fabric bow attached behind her head. Wispy straight bangs fall lightly across her forehead, while two long curled face-framing tendrils descend along her cheeks and neck.

She is seated upright on a silver Chiavari-style banquet chair, framed from approximately the waist upward. Her shoulders are relaxed, her torso angled slightly toward the camera, and both arms rest naturally downward near her lap. She wears exactly a strapless ivory-white bridal gown with a structured sweetheart bodice. The dress features layered translucent tulle along the neckline, delicate floral lace embroidery throughout the fitted bodice, subtle corset-like shaping at the waist, and a voluminous soft tulle skirt visible at the lower edge of the frame. Her shoulders, collarbones, and upper chest remain uncovered exactly as dictated by the strapless design.

In the foreground, include a gray banquet tablecloth, a clear water glass, a white ceramic cup containing an orange-colored drink, pale plates, dark chopsticks, and polished metal cutlery, softly blurred by shallow depth of field. Behind her, show a busy wedding banquet hall with seated guests, round dining tables, silver chairs, warm beige walls, dark ceiling structures, recessed spotlights, and softly illuminated architectural panels. Use warm indoor ambient lighting mixed with overhead downlights, producing gentle highlights on her face and dress without harsh shadows.

Shot on a full-frame camera with a natural 35–50mm perspective, moderate shallow depth of field, realistic facial proportions, finely resolved lace and skin detail, subtle cinematic contrast, warm-neutral white balance, restrained highlights, natural colors, and an authentic candid wedding-photography aesthetic.
